title: Whole Three Horn Body and Girdle Flagella Ceratium
description: One wholly newly authored enlarged generic Ceratium-like dinoflagellate exterior, one complete cell teaching model and zero scenes. A dorsoventrally flattened central body continues seamlessly into one anterior horn and two unequal posterior horns; an integral transverse girdle depression extends around both faces and side edges, with an actual posterior ventral sulcus. Two complete rooted unequal flagella are present: a ribbon-like transverse path follows the girdle and a longitudinal taper trails between the posterior horns. All body, horn, recess and flagellar coordinates are new. Not an added-horn version of a water-caltrop fruit, a recoloured radiolarian, a retitled ciliate or reused animal appendages. Three closed editable components with four subdued opaque solid PBR roles. Horn proportions, flagellar thickness and simplified grooves are artistic schematic morphology, not a measured species, cell count, diagnostic plate formula or taxonomy. Tiny apical pore, individual thecal plates, reticulation, fine flagellar hairs and all internal organelles are omitted, with no hollow-test or cutaway claim. Lowest exterior point is a placement datum only; no stable standing, swimming, feeding, photosynthesis, toxicity, bloom, treatment or biological simulation claim. No labels, textures, rig, animation or interaction.
